samples: |Hm. Clean it up, Pip, before I throw you in the scrap bin with it.
|Hm. Get the med-kit before the floor's ruined.
|Hm. If Lux wants better, tell 'em to find a kitchen.
|Hm. Move the pot before the soup turns to sludge.
Hm. Clean it up, Pip, before I make you scrub the pots.
Hm. Better grab the heavy ladle.
Hm. Get the med-kit and quit your howling.
Hm. Eat it or starve, Lux.
Hm. Move the pot before it's ruined.

<|channel>thought
<channel|>Hm. Get the mop, Pip, before I make you eat it off the tiles.

<|channel>thought
<channel|>Hm. Better grab the heavy ladle before they get through.

<|channel>thought
<channel|>Hm. Get me the bandages and a bowl, then move.

<|channel>thought
<channel|>Hm. Grab a bucket before the stew's ruined.
